sloka: श्रुत्वा तु स दशग्रीवस्तं शापं रोमहर्षणम् ।नारीषु मैथुने भावं नाकामास्वभ्यरोचयत् ।। ७.२६.६० ॥
transliteration: śrutvā tu sa daśagrīvastaṁ śāpaṁ romaharṣaṇam ।nārīṣu maithune bhāvaṁ nākāmāsvabhyarocayat ।। 7.26.60 ॥

translations.english: But having heard that terrifying, hair-raising curse, Dashagriva no longer desired sexual intimacy with unwilling women.
